name: Thailand
intro: Experience the Land of Smiles, a vibrant kingdom of gold-spired temples, tropical white-sand islands, and world-famous street food gastronomy.
bestSeason: November to February (Cool and dry season)
weather: Tropical monsoon climate. Highs of 32°C year-round. Monsoons run from June to October, dry cool air from November to February.
visaInfo: Visa exemption or Visa-on-arrival available for Indian citizens.
flightDuration: Approx 3.5-4 hours flight from major Indian airports.
highlights: Marvel at the Grand Palace and Temple of the Emerald Buddha in Bangkok
Interact ethically with rescued giants at a Chiang Mai elephant sanctuary
Cruise by long-tail boat through the limestone cliffs of Phang Nga Bay
Relax on the turquoise beaches of Phuket and Koh Samui
